# Applying for an appropriation

Include the customer-visible result and the newly empowered institution. Reproduce the old behavior and exercise the new decision through the public entry point. Use `npm test` for host contracts, commission commands and expansion lifecycle. After editing a canonical skill run `node scripts/sync-surfaces.js`; it updates the OpenClaw bundles and command files. Check the comparison lab before quoting a gain.

The host manifests use one project version. A version tag triggers the npm release workflow when the owner configures trusted publishing for the scope. ClawHub has a separate publication helper. A local test run publishes neither package.
